[b][u]Nordiheims First Trilateral Trade Agreement.[/u][/b]
[i]Excerpt from the Midgard Warlpiri newspaper.[/i]

The first trilateral trade agreement in Nordiheims modern history, nicknamed the new years agreement by some, was signed at the very end of 2027 with the two nations of Nevonia and the Second Flousech Republic.
It marks a new milestone in Nordiheimian international trade relations and reach as this deal will further increase the nations access into the markets of northern Vespurias and the White Strait.

While the deal contains much of the usual things such as general trade access and the potential to buy resources and raw materials it also contains a section that allows the two smaller nations to combine any purchases of Nordiheimian goods and resources into one singular order to achieve better deals and stronger negotiational power, this clause was apparently added to sweeten the deal and ease any worry that the larger marked strength of Nordiheim might dominate the smaller nations who only came out of a bloody civil war less than 3 years ago.

[spoiler=Trilateral Trade and Resource deal of 30th of Desember 2027 (Erene time)]
[b]Trade deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim, Republic of Nevonia and The Second Flousech Republic[/b]
[i]==========================================[/i]

[i][u]With this deal the three nations of Nordiheim, Nevonia and Flousech declare a trilateral trade agreement.[/u][/i]
[i][u]_T_____R_____I_____O_[/u][/i]
[u][b]Resource Section.[/b][/u]

[u][b]1.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim agrees to open its markets of [b]Oil[/b], [b]Gold[/b] and [b]Uranium[/b] to the two other nations for them to buy these resources as they need.

[u][b]1.b:[/b][/u] Nevonia agrees to open its markets of [b]Copper[/b] to the two other nations for them to buy this resource as they need.

[b][u]1.c:[/u][/b] The quantety and price of these resources will be ordered and delivered on a quarterly bassis based on fair market prices.

++++++-----------++++++----------++++++
[u][b]Trade Section.[/b][/u]

[u][b]2.a:[/b][/u] All three nations markets shall become open to each other for the flow and trade of general goods, luxury goods and services to encourage economic growth and prosperity among all three nations.

[b][u]2.b:[/u][/b] No nation are allowed to place tarifs or special taxes on goods or services from the other nations that are any higher then 5% without all nations coming together to discuss and reach a mutual agreement of understanding and consent.

++++++----------++++++----------++++++
[u][b]Special.[/b][/u]

[b][u]3:[/u][/b] The nations of Nevonia and Flousech are allowed to combine their purchases from Nordiheim into a singel purchase to attain a larger "bulk" order to achive better terms and in return will give a designated port as the place of delivery of the whole combined order.

[b][u]4:[/u][/b] All three nations declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in any of the three nations or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of this "Trilateral Trade and Resource Deal" as long as all parties can arrive at a mutual agreement on such changes.

++++++----------++++++-----------++++++

[i]Signatory parties[/i]

[u][i]Diplomat Thor Heyerdhal of The United Regions of Nordiheim[/i][/u] + [u][i]SS of FA Simen Kramer of The Republic of Nevonia[/i][/u] + [i][u]First Consul Friedrich Muller of The Secound Flousech Republic[/u][/i][/spoiler]

The diplomat that secured the deal, Mr. Thor Heyerdhal, is believed to be heavily considered for promotion to the position of Main Diplomat of both Vespurian and Elseyrian diplomatic dealings for Nordiheim in recognition of the excellent ability he showed to negotiate the deal on behalf of our nation.
[i]A picture of Thor Heyerdhal, a stocky man of medium height with a curly but well kept beard, can be seen in the excerpt where he is shaking hands with Friedrich Muller and Simen Kramer who are all smiling for the camera.[/i]

[b]Valddera Proposes Island Purchase from BR Bob[/b]
[i][b]Thursday, 16 March 2028[/b][/i]

The Federal Government of Valddera has formally approached the Bobian Empire with a proposal to purchase its island territories in East Shamat, located southwards of Valddera's maritime influence, marking a quiet but notable step in the country's external policy. The offer, delivered through diplomatic channels, but was framed not as an expansionist move but a practical arrangement rooted in geography and administration. According to officials familiar with the discussions, the Valdderan side emphasized efficiency and mutual benefit from the very beginning, with one diplomat reportedly stating during preliminary talks, "These islands are far closer to our logistical and economic reach than to yours. We believe there is a clear opportunity here for a stable and mutually beneficial transition."

The proposal includes financial compensation alongside assurances that Valddera would assume responsibility for infrastructure development, port modernization, and long-term economic integration of the islands should an agreement be reached. While BR Bob has not yet issued a formal response, sources suggest that internal deliberations are ongoing, with the matter being treated as a serious but not urgent strategic decision.

Within Valddera itself, the move has generated measured discussion across political circles without escalating into major controversy. Senior figures within he government have been quick to frame the initiative as logical extension of national policy rather than a bold and geopolitical shift. One advisor close to the leadership described it as "a matter of administrative common sense rather than ambition," adding that "terriories that are geographically aligned with Valddera's economic and logistical networks are naturally better managed with this system." This tone has been consistent across official communications, advoding any language that could be interpreted as agressive or expansionist.

As discussions remain ongoing, the outcome now largely depends on BR Bob's internal considerations and willingness to proceed with negotiations. Valddera, for its part, appears prepared to continue talks without urgency or pressure, maintaining its position that the proposal represents a practical solution rather than a strategic demand. As one member of the Valdderan delegation concluded during the initial phase of dialogue "We are ready to move forward constructively. The decision, ultimately, lies with BR Bob."

[b]Interview[/b]
Following various meetings in the morning, Strømm would take once more to the television news to answer a few public questions on the war which had arrived at the borders of Rosenmarkke.

Reporter 1: Do you believe that Wuloosya intends to continue with further strikes?
Strømm: We believe that they do, and it would be a very bad idea for themand for their allies, because we know that the Neue Republik was involved in the raid last night.
Reporter 2: Is it reasonable to assume that you will be enacting the National Emergency Defense Act?
Strømm: No, such assumptions are escalatory and risk more harm than good.
Reporter 1: Can we win this war? If the Neue Republik is involved, especially?
Strømm: To ask that question is a dangerous thing, I mean, look at the factsthe Neue Republik and Wuloosya suffer from a common pitfall; they rely heavily on electronic warfare and on modern electronics, which I believe probably will cause issues if they begin land incursions into Rosenmarkke.
Reporter 3: Hydronia recently sent aide. Do you expect the rest of THEP to send aid?
Strømm: Hydronia has been a dear ally of ours for nearly fifty years; the rest of THEP will probably send aid. 
Reporter 2: Will you win this war?
Strømm: Are you deaf? 
Reporter 4: What do you mean that modern electronics will cause issues?
Strømm: Look, look, ignore that comment, let's focus on the core issues hereRosenmarkke is under attack, and we have many things available to our armed forces and our security forces to ensure our victory over the Wuloosyans and their allies. To suggest otherwise would be a dangerous and terrible thing. Rosenmarkke will win, and if we lose, well get to it when that happens.

[spoiler=Large Natural Gas Reserves Discovered off the Coast of Wellassona]
[i]Wellassonan National News - Новеллсти Нациоьнлыы Веласоньый. Thursday, 16 March 2028[/i]

Earlier this week, The Department of Energy announced that it had discovered new natural gas reserves in Kemder, just north of the city of Buzusso, in the far northwest of the country. The reserves, which amount to nearly 30 trillion cubic metres, is considered monumental, as it increases Wellassona's known gas reserves by almost 40%. They were discovered after workers fixing undersea cables in the area stumbled upon a crack near the wires in which gas was detected. 

Prime Minister Danil Sokolova is optimistic about the findings, saying [i]"This is a monumental find. With this new gas, we shall be able to safely power our nation for the next generations".[/i] Sokolova also expressed the need to safely managed the new gas: [i]"Of course, we must be responsible in its extraction to make sure not to cause unwanted environmental damage, thus it is our main priority to ensure the safe management of the new reserves,"[/i] he said when asked about the possible environmental impact of the discovery.

Other officials also expressed excitement at the news. Energy Minister Varlam Defoov called the findings [i]"The greatest discovery of modern Wellassona, and of perhaps Elseyr"[/i]. Danil Dovlikov, CEO of Wellassona's state-owned energy company Gazent-Ris, stated that the discovery was [i]"glorious,"[/i] and that [i]"with it, Wellassona will enter a new age."[/i] Kemder Premier Karina Lagounov was also supportive, saying [i]"The new discovery is just what we need to ensure energy independence."[/i]

Opposition has arisen based on the discovery of the gas reserves. Irineya Kolesnika, Secretary of Agriculture and Head of the Green Party, voiced some concerns. Regarding the findings, she said, [i]"I personally believe that Wellassona should focus on more renewable sources, such as solar or wind power, instead of environment-harming methods such as gas."[/i] Nevertheless, she still supported the PM, adding that she [i]"trusts Mr. Sokolova to make the right decision on the gas, and to be responsible regarding the dangers it might pose."[/i]

The Otvragivod Borz, Wellassona's main stock exchange, reacted positively to the announcement, with the Borzdeks (The main Stock Market Index) rising 0.7%. The Government has stated it is open to any nations wishing to make deals regarding the new gas reserves.
